description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing collaterals associated with loans in the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving templates, listing collaterals, fetching specific collateral details, creating, updating, and deleting collateral records. The class utilizes JAX-RS annotations for REST semantics, Swagger annotations for documentation, and integrates with various Fineract services for security, data retrieval, and command processing.

classes.name: CollateralsApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource for managing loan collateral data, supporting retrieval, creation, update, and deletion operations.

methods.name: newCollateralTemplate
methods.description: Returns a template CollateralData object with default values and code lists for UI building.

methods.name: retrieveCollateralDetails
methods.description: Retrieves a list of collaterals associated with a specific loan.

methods.name: retrieveCollateralDetails (single collateral)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific collateral linked to a loan, with optional template data.

methods.name: createCollateral
methods.description: Creates a new collateral record for a specific loan based on submitted data.

methods.name: updateCollateral
methods.description: Updates details of an existing collateral for a loan.

methods.name: deleteCollateral
methods.description: Removes a collateral from a loan, if permissible.
